name: FAITHFUL | BETA
desc:
FAITHFUL is a PORT of Beatrun, the parkour gamemode from Garry's Mod.

Please do play BEATRUN if you do enjoy this game!

CREDITS
• datae (EarthyKiller127) - original creator of Beatrun
• JonnyBro and all contributors - Beatrun Community Edition
• relaxtakenotes - made Beatrun Community Edition possible
• MTB - Beatrun Reanimated animations
• Mirror's Edge by DICE / EA - the inspiration for Beatrun

Fan-made. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Facepunch Studios, DICE or Electronic Arts.

llm.loop: run and vault through parkour maps with grapple and wallruns -> chase faster times / ghost racer runs -> unlock cosmetics
llm.objectives: master momentum-based first-person parkour movement and traverse maps quickly
llm.progression: XP (2x XP pass implied); otherwise unclear
llm.instructions: description is credits only: a port of Garry's Mod Beatrun (Mirror's Edge-inspired parkour); no gameplay instructions
unique: port of a Garry's Mod parkour gamemode (Beatrun) with Mirror's Edge-style movement and reanimated animations
llm.thumbnails: stylized blue/white Mirror's Edge-like art of a runner zip-lining, balancing on pipes, and leaping between skyscrapers; FAITHFUL logo
llm.complexity_notes: custom first-person movement controller with wallrun/grapple/vault and custom animations, ghost replays, builder tool; maps appear stylized/simple
